items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I went over and grabbed and hugged them and kissed them.

ctx.x: . . . and that was the connection, and they can hear rhythmically some things. So they just dive right in.

I just thought that it’s one of the most remarkable things I ever heard, especially at that tempo that you set, and these cats didn’t miss a beat, and it was all rhyming. They did something about me. I said, for Pete’s sake. I went over and grabbed and hugged them and kissed them.
Yeah, they start throwing your name in.
